_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Nuclear Option egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Nuclear Option
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The combat flight game of near-future jets, helicopters and nuclear weapons. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if jq --arg m "{{MODDED_SERVER}}" --arg h "{{HIDDEN}}" '.ModdedServer = ($m == "1") | .Hidden = ($h == "1")' DedicatedServerConfig.json > DedicatedServerConfig.json.new; then mv -f DedicatedServerConfig.json.new DedicatedServerConfig.json; else rm -f DedicatedServerConfig.json.new; echo "DedicatedServerConfig.json isn't valid JSON, so the server starts with it as it is."; fi; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/container/linux64:/home/container/.steam/sdk64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; exec ./NuclearOptionServer.x86_64 -logFile - -limitframerate {{FRAME_RATE}}

config.startup: {"done": "[DedicatedServerManager] Waiting for Players before loading next map"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nuclear Option. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 3930080) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# Missions, bans and the server's config are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-3930080}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# DedicatedServerConfig.json is written once, with the game's own defaults;
# the Panel sets the name, password, player count and ports in it at every
# start, and the startup the true/false settings. Missions, rotation and
# bans are the owner's.
mkdir -p NuclearOption-Missions
if [ ! -f DedicatedServerConfig.json ]; then
    cat > DedicatedServerConfig.json <<'EOF'
{
  "MissionDirectory": "/home/container/NuclearOption-Missions",
  "ModdedServer": false,
  "Hidden": false,
  "ServerName": "A Nuclear Option server",
  "Port": {
    "IsOverride": true,
    "Value": 7777
  },
  "QueryPort": {
    "IsOverride": true,
    "Value": 7778
  },
  "Password": "",
  "MaxPlayers": 16,
  "BanListPaths": [
    "ban_list.txt"
  ],
  "DisableErrorKick": false,
  "ErrorKickImmuneListPaths": [],
  "NoPlayerStopTime": 30.0,
  "PostMissionDelay": 30.0,
  "RotationType": 0,
  "MissionRotation": [
    {
      "Key": {
        "Group": "BuiltIn",
        "Name": "Escalation"
      },
      "MaxTime": 7200.0
    },
    {
      "Key": {
        "Group": "BuiltIn",
        "Name": "Terminal Control"
      },
      "MaxTime": 7200.0
    }
  ]
}
EOF
    echo "Made DedicatedServerConfig.json."
fi
echo "Installed Nuclear Option build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once; the game warns that more than 16 can hurt performance.

variables.name: Modded server
variables.description: Mark the server as modded in the server browser, for servers running mods.

variables.name: Hidden
variables.description: Leave the server out of the server browser; players then join by address.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Frame rate
variables.description: The server's simulation frame limit; higher uses more CPU.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
